stories.title: Kitzbühel Final — Bublik vs. Halys, Back-to-Back on the Line
stories.angle: FOLLOW UP (July 24 pipeline) — The Generali Open Kitzbühel (ATP 250, clay) reaches its final Saturday July 25. Alexander Bublik (KAZ, defending champion, No. 1 seed) faces Quentin Halys (FRA) in the title match. Bublik beat Tomas Martin Etcheverry 6-3, 6-4 in Friday's SF; Halys beat Yannick Hanfmann 6-4, 7-6(2). If Bublik wins, he becomes the first player to defend the Kitzbühel title since 2013. Bublik leads Halys in their head-to-head record 2-0. Final result NOT yet confirmed at pipeline run time — article previews the matchup and stakes.

stories.title: Estoril Shock — Van Assche Stuns Rublev, All-French SF Set
stories.angle: FOLLOW UP (July 24 pipeline) — The biggest upset of the week: Luca Van Assche (FRA, No. 78) defeated top seed Andrey Rublev (RUS, No. 14 ATP) in the Millennium Estoril Open (ATP 250, clay) quarterfinals Friday. Van Assche called it "the biggest win of my career." Rublev had been dominant earlier in the week — his 6-1, 6-1 win in 59 minutes over Skatov was described by the ATP as his "most dominant win of 2026." Also in the QFs: Hugo Gaston (FRA) def. Tiago Torres (POR, wild card) 6-3, 6-4; Luciano Darderi (ITA, No. 2 seed) def. opponent 2-6, 7-5, 6-2 (Tour-leading 22nd clay win of 2026). Saturday's SFs: Gaston vs. Van Assche (all-French); Darderi vs. Alexander Blockx (BEL, No. 4). SF results not yet indexed.

stories.title: National Bank Open — Sinner, Djokovic, Alcaraz, Draper All Out
stories.angle: FOLLOW UP (July 24 pipeline) — The withdrawal wave for the National Bank Open (Aug. 1 women's Toronto, Aug. 4 men's Montreal) has reached a new level. Confirmed out: Jannik Sinner (ITA, ATP No. 1, elbow), Novak Djokovic (SRB, injury), Carlos Alcaraz (ESP, No. 2, injury), Jack Draper (GBR, No. 5, arm recurrence). With the top 5 players by ranking stripped from the men's draw, Alexander Zverev, Ben Shelton, and Daniil Medvedev stand to inherit an open field. Sinner quote: "After carefully considering all the factors together with my team, we have made the difficult decision to withdraw from Montreal. It is never easy to miss such an important event, but we believe this is the right decision to prioritize my health." On the women's side, Jasmine Paolini (ITA, foot) also confirmed out.

stories.title: WTA Hamburg Semifinals — Sherif, Kalinina, Oliynykova, Bondar
stories.angle: FOLLOW UP (July 24 pipeline) — The MSC Hamburg Ladies Open (WTA 250, clay, July 20-26) reaches its semifinals Saturday. After Friday's QF results: Mayar Sherif (EGY) defeated Paula Badosa (ESP) 6-2, 6-3; Anhelina Kalinina (UKR) defeated Tamara Korpatsch (GER) 6-1, 6-3; Oleksandra Oliynykova (UKR, No. 1 seed) defeated Elina Avanesyan (ARM) 6-3, 2-6, 6-2; Anna Bondar (HUN) defeated Alina Charaeva 3-6, 7-5, 6-1. Saturday SF pairings: Sherif vs. Kalinina; Bondar vs. Oliynykova. Final Sunday.
